name: instance-model-editor-layout
description: InstanceSheet per-model settings desktop geometry: inside .fieldInline, .fieldGrow stretches the Input up to the Reset link button; inside .modelRow, .modelNameSlot wraps a long unbroken model ID without pushing .modelMeta past the row's right edge.

mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-12: without flex: 1 1 0 on .fieldGrow, inputWidth shrinks to 221px inside the 434px .fieldInline row, failing both the slack bound and inputWidth > 260.
